manifest.method: For each fixed matched pair and tokenizer, encode with tiktoken.get_encoding(model).encode(text); delta = tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english). Per-tokenizer value = arithmetic mean across all eight pairs. Headline value = max of per-tokenizer means, the lower_better protocol worst case (least saving). No special tokens.
manifest.sampling_note: Eight pairs fixed before filing: capability and permission; positive, negative, and modal contexts; three actor/action families. English baselines explicitly disambiguate the same semantic fork rather than using bare can.
